summary.zh: 点餐、到店取餐与活动查询

description.zh: 查询麦当劳中国的菜单、优惠活动，办理麦乐送点餐与到店取餐。需要先在开放平台申请 MCP Token，连接时填入。
description.en: Browse menus and promotions, order delivery or pickup from McDonald's China. Request an MCP token on the open platform and enter it when connecting.

authHint.zh: 在开放平台用手机号登录并申请 MCP Token，填入后连接。
authHint.en: Sign in on the open platform, request an MCP token, then connect.
